description: This Java class handles commands to post interest for recurring deposit accounts in the Fineract system. It implements command processing logic, delegating the actual posting of interest to a service layer. The class is annotated for Spring's dependency injection and transaction management, and is identified as handling the POSTINTEREST action for RECURRINGDEPOSITACCOUNT entities.

classes.name: PostInterestRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles commands to post interest on recurring deposit accounts, delegating core operation to the DepositAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to post interest by calling the service layer with the entity ID and deposit account type.
